Good news about water breaks
It is for returning guests
Travelers with pets should check their documents early and pack only the items that the Companion Animal Travel Desk approves.

For large dogs, bring the health certificate and crate details to the desk for review. <<FACT F081>> <<FACT F063>> Keep your pet calm, use gentle handling, and follow staff guidance if anything seems unclear. The team will review concerns in a calm, stepwise way and help you avoid last-minute problems.

Bird travelers need the right release paperwork and a suitable carrier before check-in. <<FACT F077>> Keep the animal secure, limit stress, and make sure the carrier stays clean and closed during the journey. If you are unsure about any requirement, the desk can check the paperwork before you arrive at the airport.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel so we can help you prepare with care.
